question: Which is the RBI's vision document titled 'Payment And Settlement Systems In India'.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Vision 2019-2021**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Reserve Bank of India's (RBI) vision document titled "Payment and Settlement Systems in India" is Vision 2019 - 2021.
 
• The document's core theme is "Empowering Exceptional (E)payment Experience".
 
• The vision aims to: 
 
 
• Make e-payment options safe, secure, convenient, quick, and affordable for all Indians 
 
• Achieve a "highly digital" and "cash-lite" society 
 
• Increase digital transactions fourfold in two years 
 
• Reduce paper-based clearing as a percentage of retail payments 
 
 
 
• The document also focuses on: innovation, cybersecurity, financial inclusion, customer protection, and competition. 
 
• The RBI's Payments Vision 2025 builds on the initiatives of Vision 2019 - 2021.
 
• It emphasizes five anchor goalposts: integrity, inclusion, innovation, institutionalization, and internationalization
